mainEntity.name: What are the leading frontier models in 2026?

acceptedAnswer.text: Anthropic Claude Opus 4.8, OpenAI GPT-5.5, Google Gemini 3.5 Pro, and DeepSeek V4.

mainEntity.name: How has model pricing evolved in 2026?

acceptedAnswer.text: Frontier model token prices have fallen significantly, with high-efficiency tier models like Haiku 4.5 costing around $1 per million input tokens.

mainEntity.name: What is the significance of unified reasoning in GPT-5.5?

acceptedAnswer.text: OpenAI retired separate reasoning models (o-series), integrating dynamic reasoning modes directly into the primary GPT-5 architecture.

mainEntity.name: Which model performs best for codebase engineering?

acceptedAnswer.text: Claude Opus 4.8 and Sonnet 4.6 maintain industry leadership in long-context coding and multi-file refactoring accuracy.

mainEntity.name: Why is context caching critical for cost optimization?

acceptedAnswer.text: Prompt caching reduces repetitive token charges by up to 90 percent on large codebase contexts and multi-turn workflows.
